candidate: Anisotropic Clifford-vector star inequality and canonical-EB support

claims.statement: For any selected k-subset of physical Clifford generators, the ordinary-tensor A_i,B_i operators satisfy the stated commuting/anticommuting relations. For odd k, the restricted algebra has central signs C=product B_i and D=product A_i; both signs are handled separately by canonical parity blocks. If k<m, ambient A_l and B_l for l outside the subset flip C and D independently, so all four physical sectors occur with equal rank.
claims.finite_check_result: Exact m=5,k=3 matrices satisfy all relations; all four (C,D) sectors have rank 16; each sector characteristic polynomial is the fourth power of the matching canonical rank-4 block polynomial.

claims.statement: For every k-subset, the physical unweighted ordinary-tensor star has operator norm at most k+1. The SOS identity holds for both twist signs, and the k=1 physical case follows directly by the triangle inequality.
For real PSD Q supported on the Clifford vector space, lambda_max(H_Q) <= Tr_HS(Q)+lambda_max(Q), by Spin diagonalization and sorted-weight layercake.

The canonical measure-and-prepare support is lambda_max(Q). The upper bound follows from the Clifford expectation-vector norm bound; attainment uses the projective measurement of a largest-weight generator and prepares the normalized effects.
A full Spin(m) orbit of one Clifford eigenstate is not generally an anisotropic support maximizer; its score is Tr(Q)/m.
claims.repair: Use the projective POVM for a largest-eigenvalue Clifford generator, or refine it into a rank-one eigenbasis.

scope: Q is a real symmetric PSD matrix on the real Clifford-vector frame. A general complex-Hermitian coefficient matrix on the complexified span is not covered.
The star bound controls only the Clifford-vector sector; it does not prove the full all-Q or common full-channel EB comparison.
Exact arithmetic was run for the physical m=5,k=3 restricted odd subset; the all-m,k argument is algebraic and independently reconstructed in REPORT.md.
external_validation: NONE; no web search was needed for this algebraic audit.
